nodes.author: SarrafAnushka
nodes.text: The news of an HMPV outbreak in China is alarming as the world is still grappling with the aftermath of COVID-19. It’s time for global leaders to unite and demand accountability from China regarding the potential lab origins of such viruses. We cannot risk repeating history.
